text:
The testimony should be admitted because the engineer was a party opponent's agent/employee and his deposition statements concern matters within the scope of his employment, making them admissible as statements of a party opponent under the evidence rules, and unavailability plus prior deposition under oath also supports admissibility. The fact that the deposition was from separate wrongful termination litigation does not bar it, since the company had an opportunity to cross-examine him at that deposition.  
CONFIDENCE: 62
